text: {"v":1,"mode":"lesson","intent":"Illustrate the Riemann zeta critical strip, critical line, and sparse off-line zeros","scene":{"family":"drawing"},"steps":[{"caption":"This schematic complex plane shows the critical strip between real parts 0 and 1.","draw":[{"op":"line","from":[90,310],"to":[540,310],"id":"real-axis"},{"op":"line","from":[90,330],"to":[90,40],"id":"imag-axis"},{"op":"rect","origin":[170,60],"size":[300,250],"id":"critical-strip"},{"op":"label","target":"critical-strip","text":"critical strip 0 < Re(s) < 1"},{"op":"label","at":[500,330],"text":"Re(s)","size":18},{"op":"label","at":[45,55],"text":"Im(s)","size":18}]},{"caption":"The critical line is Re(s) = 1/2; zeros are shown schematically, concentrated there with only a few off-line examples.","draw":[{"op":"line","from":[320,60],"to":[320,310],"id":"critical-line"},{"op":"label","target":"critical-line","text":"Re(s) = 1/2"},{"op":"circle","center":[320,100],"radius":7,"id":"zero1"},{"op":"circle","center":[320,145],"radius":7,"id":"zero2"},{"op":"circle","center":[320,190],"radius":7,"id":"zero3"},{"op":"circle","center":[320,235],"radius":7,"id":"zero4"},{"op":"circle","center":[320,275],"radius":7,"id":"zero5"},{"op":"circle","center":[250,130],"radius":7,"id":"offzero1"},{"op":"circle","center":[390,215],"radius":7,"id":"offzero2"},{"op":"line","from":[185,85],"to":[215,115]},{"op":"line","from":[185,115],"to":[215,145]},{"op":"line","from":[425,85],"to":[455,115]},{"op":"line","from":[425,115],"to":[455,145]},{"op":"brace","from":[180,75],"to":[180,150],"side":-1},{"op":"label","at":[100,165],"text":"rare off-line region","size":16}]}],"claims":[],"takeaway":"This is an illustrative schematic, not a plot of measured zero locations: the central line is emphasized, while off-line zeros are represented as sparse."}
